description: Verifies the relativistic hydrodynamics stack: ideal gas and Synge equations of state, the conserved to primitive inversion for hydrodynamic, ultra-relativistic and magnetized states, WENO5 and MP5 reconstruction, the HLL, HLLC and HLLD solvers, constrained transport and the relativistic Sod and Balsara 1 shock tubes.

checks.label: the ideal gas pressure equals (Gamma - 1) rho eps
the specific internal energy is recovered from the pressure
the specific enthalpy equals 1 + eps + p / rho
the sound speed squared is positive and below Gamma - 1
the pressure is recovered from the enthalpy
the Synge enthalpy exceeds 1
the Synge sound speed squared lies in (0, 1/3]
a hydrodynamic state round trips within 1e-10
an ultra-relativistic state with v = 0.999 round trips within 1e-8
a magnetized state round trips within 1e-6
the magnetic field is recovered within 1e-12
WENO5 reconstructs the left face of a smooth profile within 1e-6
MP5 reconstructs the left face of a smooth profile within 1e-6
WENO5 stays within the data bounds across a discontinuity
a uniform static state has no mass flux for HLL, HLLC and HLLD
a uniform static state has a momentum flux equal to the pressure for HLL, HLLC and HLLD
the HLL momentum flux of the Sod interface is positive
the HLLC momentum flux of the Sod interface is positive
the initial field derived from a vector potential is divergence free
the divergence stays below 1e-12 over fifty updates
the left state is undisturbed at t = 0.4
the right density is undisturbed at t = 0.4
the shocked region has a velocity between 0.60 and 0.80
the pressure of the shocked region lies between 0.01 and 5
every cell keeps a finite positive density and pressure and a subluminal velocity
every cell keeps a finite positive density and pressure, a subluminal velocity and a finite transverse field
